items.title: Watched-node alerts
items.detail: Tap the bell on a node’s detail page to watch it. Get push alerts when the node goes quiet or is heard again if your CoreScope administrator has enabled NodeScope Push. Turn on push for this device in your CoreScope account settings.

items.title: Reported repeater details
items.detail: See community-reported status and equipment on supported CoreScope analyzers. Use reported antenna height and gain in Estimated Coverage and Link Profile.

items.title: Favorite channels
items.detail: Find your favorite channels together at the top of the Channels list.

items.title: Find an analyzer
items.detail: Browse community analyzers grouped by country, or choose Sort by nearest to find sources close to you.

items.title: Radio settings for your mesh
items.detail: New Link Profile and Estimated Coverage studies start with radio settings for your mesh. The MeshCore preset for Brazil is also available.

items.title: NodeVision
items.detail: Use your camera to see which way nearby mesh nodes are, or open NodeVision from a node’s details to find that node.

items.title: Manage your repeaters
items.detail: Sign in to CoreScope to claim repeaters you maintain, update their reported equipment and status, or remove a claim.

items.title: Saved Plans
items.detail: Group link profiles and coverage studies into named plans, with notes. Results are saved with them and open on iPhone, iPad and Android alike, without calculating again.

items.title: Share and back up plans
items.detail: Export a study, a plan or your whole library as a file to send or keep. Open a NodeScope file to import a copy; nothing in your library is replaced.
items.location: Saved Plans → a study or plan's menu, or Back up library

items.title: Unsaved work is kept
items.detail: Changes you haven't saved survive switching analyzer or NodeScope closing. Pick them up again from Saved Plans.

items.title: Estimated Coverage (Beta)
items.detail: Place a transmitter anywhere and see where it's likely to be heard, based on terrain and your radio settings. Tap the map to check any spot.

items.title: Link Profile
items.detail: Check whether two locations can hear each other: see the terrain between them, how much clearance the signal has, and the expected margin.

items.title: Better on iPad and Mac
items.detail: Cleaner sidebars on iPad, and keyboard shortcuts: ⌘1–⌘5 switch tabs, ⌘F searches, ⌘R refreshes.
